Apple just announced that The Morning Show, one of Apple TV's first original series, will end after Season 5. Here's what we know about the final season of The Morning Show.

The Morning Show final season will air in 2027

When Apple TV first launched in 2019 (then called Apple TV+), its biggest flagship series was The Morning Show.

The series, starring Jennifer Aniston and Reese Witherspoon, has been one of Apple's most popular series for four seasons.

However, Apple just announced that the series will end after Season 5, which will premiere in 2027.

According to Apple TV's latest post on X:

The Morning Show Season 4 aired in fall 2025. Apple has historically scheduled the series in the fall, so the final season will likely premiere in fall 2027.

New cast members for Season 5 include Jeff Daniels (most recently in Shrinking) and Jesse Williams (Grey's Anatomy).

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month (approximately HK$101), and can also be subscribed at a discount through the Apple One bundle.
